answer.why: Grid Dynamics provides AI, cloud, data, and digital engineering services to Fortune 1000 enterprises [T:P1.1–T:P1.7, T:P2.1–T:P2.2]. EPAM provides software engineering, AI, cloud, data, design and consulting services to enterprises across the same industries [C:P1.1–C:P1.2, C:P1.9–C:P1.10]. Both sit in the same value-chain position (IT service provider), use the same revenue model (T&M/project-based engineering), target the same customer segment (large enterprises), and compete in the same end markets (financial services, retail, tech, healthcare). They are direct peers.
answer.reason: Both companies are enterprise digital transformation and engineering services firms offering AI, cloud, data and software engineering services to large enterprises on a T&M/project basis. The services, customers, and business model are essentially identical.

customer_segment.reason: Grid Dynamics explicitly targets Fortune 1000 enterprises [T:P1.2]. EPAM serves enterprises across multiple countries and industries [C:P1.10]. Both are pure B2B, large-enterprise focused.
